verdict: ROAS stays above 3.8x, but purchase pace has slowed this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,740 in revenue on $1,485 in spend — a 3.86x return — with 33 purchases recorded. That overall number is solid, but the most recent 7 days showed purchases down 28.57% and ROAS slipping 8.76% against the prior 7 days, even as daily spend ticked up slightly. The likely driver is creative fatigue: your top campaign has absorbed the majority of budget and purchase volume has been near zero on most individual days across the past six weeks. Ad creative is being refreshed this period to address that, and subscription pages and conversion tracking — both overdue — are being prioritised now so the funnel can be measured and optimised cleanly. October's milestones include a full tier-expansion scaling push and lifecycle automation going live, which should give both paid and organic performance more infrastructure to build on.
